documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Announcement Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015- Updates
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: JG Chemicals reported its best-ever quarterly performance in Q2 FY27 with record revenue, EBITDA, and PAT, driven by healthy demand across end-user industries, favorable product mix, and focused execution. The company is expanding its manufacturing footprint with the Dahej greenfield project nearing completion and the Naidupeta brownfield expansion on track for commissioning. Management remains confident in strong demand momentum across the tire, auto, and non-rubber sectors, while advancing strategic initiatives in sustainability and specialized zinc derivatives. J.G. Chemicals reported its best-ever quarterly performance in Q2 FY27, achieving record revenue, EBITDA, and PAT.

guidance.claim: The company targets reaching closer to a 14% to 15% EBITDA margin in the next 3 years as the share of value-added products increases.
guidance.quote: So I think on a blended basis, we are confident that in the next 3 years or so, we should be closer to the 14% to 15% EBITDA margin with the share of value-added products increasing.

guidance.claim: Management expects peak revenue potential of the Dahej facility to reach INR900 crores during the FY29 to FY30 period.
guidance.quote: I think the INR900 crores that you're talking about should be closer to FY29 to FY '30, that's the period in which we should be able to achieve this number.

guidance.claim: Management targets an EBITDA margin level of about 14% to 15% with a higher share of value-added products.
guidance.quote: So, going forward, our target would be to get to an EBITDA margin level of about 14% to 15% with the higher share of value-added products that we are foraying into now.

demand_outlook.claim: The company is witnessing strong demand across all customer end-user applications in Q3.
demand_outlook.quote: Even currently in Q3, we are witnessing strong demand across all our customer end-user applications, and we are confident of surpassing the numbers achieved till now.

demand_outlook.claim: The automotive industry maintained strong momentum in Q2 FY27, supported by festive demand.
demand_outlook.quote: The automotive industry maintained strong momentum in Q2 FY27, supported by festive demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Indian tyre majors are investing approximately Rs 25,000 crore to meet growing OEM and replacement demand.
demand_outlook.quote: Despite West Asia disruptions, Indian tyre majors are progressing with approximately ₹25,000 crore of announced capex to meet growing OEM and replacement demand and expand exports, which account for around 25% of Indian tyre production.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand momentum across the tire industry remained robust through the previous quarter and Q4 ending FY26 and has continued into the current quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: As far as demand is concerned, our customers, the tire and the rubber, remain the largest pillar of our business, and demand momentum across the tire industry remained robust through the previous quarter and Q4 ending FY26, and this has continued into the current quarter also.

demand_outlook.claim: Q1 FY27 saw volume growth across major vehicle categories such as passenger vehicles, two-wheelers, commercial vehicles, and three-wheelers year-on-year.
demand_outlook.quote: As per ATMA, the Q1 FY27 saw volume growth across major vehicle categories: passenger vehicles growing up to 26.6%, two-wheelers 16.5%, commercial vehicles 16.48%, and three-wheelers more than 11% year-on-year.

demand_outlook.claim: The company continues to see encouraging traction in non-rubber segments such as pharmaceuticals, ceramics, specialty chemicals, and agriculture.
demand_outlook.quote: As far as the non-rubber applications are concerned, outside the rubber and tire, we continue to see encouraging traction in the non-rubber segment such as pharmaceuticals, ceramics, specialty chemicals, and agri.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 1 of the Dahej greenfield project comprising approximately 15,000 metric tons per annum is nearing completion with trial runs scheduled for next month.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 1, comprising approximately 15,000 metric tons per annum of zinc oxide capacity within the planned 40,000-plus metric tons facility, is nearing completion now with trial runs scheduled for next month.

capex_expansion.claim: The Naidupeta brownfield expansion is expected to add approximately 5,000 metric tons and is planned for commissioning in January.
capex_expansion.quote: The Naidupeta facility, you're right, it's planned for Q3, but I think it will spill over to about mid- to end Jan. So I think mid-January target. So within January, we will commission that.

capex_expansion.claim: BDJ Oxides Private Limited acquired approximately 16.74 acres of freehold land at Naidupeta in Tirupati District during 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: Further strengthening our long-term expansion plan, JG, through its material subsidiary, BDJ Oxides Private Limited, acquired approximately 16.74 acres of freehold land at Naidupeta in Tirupati District, Andhra during 2026.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 2 of the Dahej facility is planned to start sometime in the 2028 calendar year.
capex_expansion.quote: Company's commitment -- so Phase 2 of the Dahej would start sometime in 2028 calendar year.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 1 of the Dahej greenfield project is nearing completion, with trial runs scheduled for next month.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 1 of the Dahej greenfield project, comprising approximately 15,000 MTPA of zinc oxide capacity within the planned 40,000+ MTPA facility, is nearing completion, with trial runs scheduled for next month.

capex_expansion.claim: The Naidupeta brownfield expansion is on track for commissioning in Q4 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: The Naidupeta brownfield expansion remains on track for commissioning in Q4 FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: BDJ Oxides Pvt Ltd acquired 16.74 acres of land at Naidupeta in 2026 to support future growth.
capex_expansion.quote: Our material subsidiary i.e. BDJ Oxides Pvt Ltd has acquired approximately 16.74 acres of freehold land at Naidupeta, Tirupati district, Andhra Pradesh, in 2026, to support future capacity expansion and long-term growth.

capex_expansion.claim: The Gujarat project is targeted for commissioning in Q3 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: With the addition of Gujarat project targeted for commissioning in Q3 FY27, and once both phases of the Dahej plant are on stream, our combined zinc chemical capacity will exceed 1,15,000 metric tons per annum, a scale that would position us amongst the top three zinc chemical producers globally.

capex_expansion.claim: The brownfield expansion at the Naidupeta facility is expected to be commissioned in Q3 of the current financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: The brownfield expansion at our Naidupeta facility is also progressing well in parallel, and we expect to commission that also in the Q3 of the current financial year.

capex_expansion.claim: The Dahej greenfield facility involves an investment of about INR100 crores with an estimated revenue potential of INR900 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: With an investment of about INR100 crores, the estimated revenue potential will be INR900 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 1 of the Dahej zinc greenfield chemical facility is targeted for commissioning in Q3 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 1 of the zinc oxide production is targeted for commissioning, as I mentioned, in Q3 FY27.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated revenue from operations for Q2 FY27 stood at INR361.01 crores with an EBITDA margin of 10.71%.
margins_costs.quote: For Q2 FY27, our consolidated revenue from operations stood at INR361.01 crores, registering a year-on-year growth of 64% and a sequential growth of 14%. EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR38.65 crores, up 77% year-on-year and 7% sequentially with an EBITDA margin of 10.71%.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax for Q2 FY27 was INR27.95 crores with a PAT margin of 7.74%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax stood at INR27.95 crores, registering a year-on-year growth of 86% and a sequential growth of 7%. The PAT margin for the quarter was 7.74%.

margins_costs.claim: H1 FY27 consolidated revenue from operations was INR676.66 crores with an EBITDA margin of 11.07%.
margins_costs.quote: For H1, our consolidated revenue from operations stood at INR676.66 crores, registering a year-on-year growth of 54%. EBITDA was at INR74.9 crores, up 66% year-on-year with an EBITDA margin of 11.07%.

margins_costs.claim: The company's pricing model allows for the pass-through of zinc price movements to mitigate raw material price risk.
margins_costs.quote: The Company’s pricing model enables pass-through of zinc price movements, helping mitigate raw material price risk.

margins_costs.claim: Management expects further margin improvement as new capacities ramp up and value-added products contribute more to revenue.
margins_costs.quote: Sustained profitability across both quarters supports management’s expectation of further margin improvement as new capacities ramp up and value-added products contribute a greater share of revenue.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated EBITDA for Q1 FY27 was INR36.3 crores with a margin of 11.5% compared to 10.64% in the corresponding quarter last year.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA for the current quarter was INR36.3 crores with a margin of 11.5% as compared to 10.64% in the corresponding quarter last year.

margins_costs.claim: PAT for Q1 FY27 was INR26.1 crores with a PAT margin of 8.27% compared to 7.52% in Q1 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: The PAT for the quarter was INR26.1 crores with a PAT margin of 8.27% as compared to 7.52% in Q1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that the company is neutral to zinc prices.
margins_costs.quote: We are neutral to zinc prices, if you ask me honestly.

orders_capacity.claim: Installed capacity of zinc oxide is almost 77,000 metric tons per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: As India's largest player in the industry with an installed capacity of almost 77,000 metric tons per annum, JGC is very well positioned to benefit from this consolidation trend going forward.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has an installed capacity of 10,000 metric tons for zinc sulphate.
orders_capacity.quote: We have installed a capacity of 10,000 metric tons for zinc sulphate.

orders_capacity.claim: Post completion of phase expansions at Dahej and Naidupeta, installed capacity will be over 115,000 tons of zinc chemicals.
orders_capacity.quote: In fact, post the completion of the phase expansions at Dahej and Naidupeta, our installed capacity would be over 115,000 tons of zinc chemicals, making us amongst the top 3 players in zinc chemicals globally.

orders_capacity.claim: Zinc oxide capacity utilization exceeded 80% in Q2 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: JGC continued to deliver double-digit volume growth, with zinc oxide capacity utilisation exceeding 80% and further improvement expected.

orders_capacity.claim: Total zinc oxide capacity is expected to reach 79,904 MTPA following the commissioning of new projects.
orders_capacity.quote: Together, these additions will increase total zinc oxide capacity to 79,904 MTPA, providing capacity to support anticipated demand through FY28 and FY29.

orders_capacity.claim: Combined installed manufacturing capacity at West Bengal and Andhra Pradesh facilities is close to 70,000 metric tons per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: Our manufacturing is anchored at our facilities in West Bengal and Andhra Pradesh, which together today command an installed capacity of close to 70,000 metric tons per annum.

orders_capacity.claim: Utilization levels are in the early 80s.
orders_capacity.quote: So, the utilization levels are in early 80s right now as we speak.

orders_capacity.claim: Phase 1 of the Dahej project will have a capacity in the range of 15,000 to 17,000 tons per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: Phase 1, as I just mentioned in the previous question, would be in the range of 15,000 to 17,000 tons per annum, and the revenue potential would be in the range of INR300 crores to INR400 crores, and the EBITDA margins that we expect to generate from that project would be in the 11% to 12% range.

capital_allocation.claim: The company had a net cash surplus of INR63.3 crores as of 30th September 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: We have a net cash surplus of INR63.3 crores as per 30th September 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is incorporating a new subsidiary in Dubai to diversify raw material sourcing.
capital_allocation.quote: To further strengthen its international presence, JGC is incorporating BDJ Materials and Metals Trading FZCO, Dubai, as a step-down wholly owned subsidiary.

capital_allocation.claim: The company proposed to incorporate BDJ Materials and Metal Trading FZCO in Dubai, UAE as a wholly-owned subsidiary of BDJ Oxides Private Limited.
capital_allocation.quote: Recently, the company has also proposed to incorporate BDJ Materials and Metal Trading FZCO in Dubai, UAE, which upon incorporation will become a wholly owned subsidiary of BDJ Oxides Private Limited, a material subsidiary of JG Chemicals, and consequently a step-down wholly-owned subsidiary of JG Chemicals Limited.

risks_headwinds.claim: Ongoing geopolitical conflict had impacted global supply chains for zinc dross, the primary raw material.
risks_headwinds.quote: As we had mentioned earlier, the ongoing geopolitical conflict had impacted global supply chains for Zinc Dross, which is our primary raw material.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to reach a consolidated EBITDA margin closer to 14% to 15% in 3 years' time.
management_commitments.quote: I think as far as we are concerned, the company is looking at a consolidated EBITDA margin of closer to 14% to 15% in 3 years' time.

management_commitments.claim: Phase 2 of the Dahej facility will start sometime in the 2028 calendar year.
management_commitments.quote: Company's commitment -- so Phase 2 of the Dahej would start sometime in 2028 calendar year.

management_commitments.claim: Commissioning of new capacities in Gujarat and Naidupeta.
management_commitments.quote: New capacities in Gujarat and Naidupeta are expected to be commissioned during FY27

management_commitments.claim: Operations for specialized zinc derivatives at the Gujarat plant to commence.
Phase 1 of the Dahej plant is estimated to be commissioned in November.
management_commitments.quote: I would say, it will be sometime in November would be a good estimate.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
